title: Foundry, a manufacturing-as-a-service startup that builds factories with robots powered by physical AI models, raised a $100M Series A led by Marlinspike (Rocket Drew/The Information)
summary: Rocket Drew / The Information: Foundry, a manufacturing-as-a-service startup that builds factories with robots powered by physical AI models, raised a $100M Series A led by Marlinspike — Large companies have learned over the past couple years that they can get more mileage out of AI agents by rethinking their processes from scratch …
